Profile Summary

Results-oriented Senior Executive with over 1 year and 5 months of professional experience in field sales and back-office operations. Proven track record in B2B client acquisition, lead management, and conducting face-to-face meetings to onboard manufacturers, traders, and wholesalers. Possesses a solid academic foundation with an MBA/PGDM (2025) and comprehensive skills in data entry, Excel, Tally software, and MS Office. Seeking to leverage expertise in client relations and operational support within a dynamic and challenging business environment.

Senior Executive

IndiaMART

IndiaMart is a B2B platform which provides the customer in the form of leads to the manufacturer, traders and wholesaler. My role is senior sales executive, It is a field sales job role, the company will provide some data I have to do calls in that data and fix the meeting with that clients, and meet them face to face, explain about IndiaMart subscription plans and services and I have to convince them to onboard on IndiaMart plans I used to meet 3 to 4 clients daily who are all manufacturers, traders, wholesalers and distributors.
